origin.description: Extract every segment between text boundaries.
origin.usage: stri_extract_all_boundaries(str, simplify = FALSE, omit_no_match = FALSE, ..., opts_brkiter = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: FALSE returns a list. TRUE pads a matrix with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: TRUE returns an empty vector when there is no segment. FALSE returns one NA.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: Break-iterator settings. NULL uses the line breaker.

origin.details: Vectorized over str. A skip_* flag drops every segment whose ending boundary has that ICU rule status. The skipped text is not joined to the next segment. An omitted skip acts as FALSE. Indexes are 1-based inclusive code points. A missing string is a one-element NA vector even when omit_no_match is TRUE. simplify TRUE or NA calls stri_list2matrix by row with a minimum width of 0.
origin.value: A list of character vectors, or a character matrix when simplify is not FALSE.
origin.example:
found <- stri_extract_all_boundaries("a b", type = "word", skip_word_none = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_extract_all_boundaries("a b", type = "word", skip_word_none = TRUE) returns ', paste(found[[1]], collapse = ", "), '.\n'))

translation.description: Extract every segment between text boundaries.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those. None is an empty vector.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: False returns a list of character vectors. True pads with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: True returns an empty vector when there is no segment. False returns one NA.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: A dict of supplied break-iterator settings.

translation.details: A skip_* flag drops every segment whose ending boundary has that ICU rule status. The skipped text is not joined to the next segment. An omitted skip is false. Positions are 1-based inclusive code points. BreakIterator indexes are UTF-16 code units and are converted before they are returned. NA stays missing. The string "NA" is text. A missing string is a one-element NA vector even when omit_no_match is true. simplify true pads by row with an empty string. simplify equal to NA pads with NA.
translation.value: A list of character vectors, or a list of rows when simplify is not false.
translation.example:
from stringi.boundary import stri_extract_all_boundaries
found = stri_extract_all_boundaries("a b", type="word", skip_word_none=True)
print('stri_extract_all_boundaries("a b", type="word", skip_word_none=True) returns ' + ", ".join(found[0]) + ".")
